prompt:
A photorealistic photograph of the same medical check-up as in the first reference picture, a minute later, in a tall vertical picture, caught in the middle of the examination. The same room, the same plain sage-green wall with its white skirting board, the same light-grey vinyl floor, the same white column scale with its height rod in the same place against the wall, the same soft even daylight, the same 50 mm lens from the same place at the height of the patient's chest, everything in sharp focus.

The first reference picture is the scene a minute earlier, seen from the same place. The second reference picture shows the young man from behind: his back, the back of his head and his hair stay exactly as in it. The third reference picture shows his family doctor: her face, skin, hair and bun stay exactly as in it.

THE PATIENT has turned around and now stands with his back to the camera, in the middle of the picture, and fills most of its height: the top of his head sits just below the top edge, and his bare heels stand on the light-grey floor just above the bottom edge, with their shadow under them. He wears only the same plain dark navy-blue cotton boxer shorts. His whole back shows, from the back of his neck down to the waistband of his shorts: the line of his spine running down the middle, his two shoulder blades, the backs of his shoulders. Below the shorts, the backs of his thighs, the hollows behind his knees, his calves and his two heels, his feet a little apart with a band of floor between them. His two arms hang at his sides, each one a hand's width out from his body with a band of wall between arm and waist, his hands open and empty, turned so that both palms face backwards, towards the camera, with the fingers slightly spread: the camera sees the inside of each hand, palm and fingers. He holds his head straight and breathes in deeply, as the doctor asked.

THE DOCTOR is the woman of the third reference picture, in the same white coat over the same pale-blue blouse. She stands in the right part of the picture, beside him at arm's length, level with him, her body turned towards his back and her face in profile, attentive. The earpieces of her black stethoscope are in her ears, and her hand nearer to him rests its round chest piece on the side of his back nearer to her, between his spine and his shoulder blade. Her other hand hangs empty at her side.

Apart from the scale, the space between and around the two people is that same sage wall and grey floor, and the open floor runs on in front of them down to the bottom edge of the picture.
